importance_settings.measure: validation score minus the score with the column shuffled

note: The control is ew-redeploy (the live executor with the redeploy of idle cash, profit_taking.control_options) under policy_v4.allocator(mask); the overlay is the same run with the allocator wrapped: the lowest-forecast ceil(0.1 n) of the n >= 5 names with a positive target and a forecast get no target, the rest the policy's equal weight under the 20% cap; no mid-cycle trims. Both lines are priced on identical sessions from each of the first `offsets` sessions; medians and worsts across offsets; paired statistics at the median offset. The model window runs from the first forecast date through 2023-12-29.
